# @three-ws/autopilot-mcp

> An AI agent's own autonomous-execution control plane over MCP — set autopilot scopes, a daily SOL spend cap, and auto-execute, then run the propose → execute → undo loop. The agent spends SOL and never sells $THREE. Authenticated, write-heavy; scope + spend enforcement is server-side.

@three-ws/autopilot-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/autopilot-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/autopilot-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/autopilot-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/autopilot-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/autopilot-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
